s01: A cozy living room seen from the front. A long sand-coloured sofa spans the width. The green mascot sits at the far left end looking down at a small phone; the terracotta mascot sits at the far right end, turned slightly away, also looking at a phone. A wide empty gap of sofa between them. A small round wooden table with a warm glowing lamp in front. They live together but side by side, like flatmates.
s02: A home hallway. The green mascot walks to the left carrying a small briefcase; the terracotta mascot walks to the right carrying a paper grocery bag and a tiny child's backpack. They pass each other without looking at each other. Small motion marks. Everyday routine, nothing dramatic.
s03: The same cozy living room with the long sand-coloured sofa, now filled with soft grey-sage fog. The green mascot at the left and the terracotta mascot at the right are half hidden in the fog and cannot see each other. No map, no light yet, just quiet fog between them.
s04: A valley between soft hills completely filled with thick, soft grey-sage fog. In the foreground a wooden signpost with three blank arrow boards pointing in three different directions into the fog. The green mascot and the terracotta mascot stand small and apart near the signpost, seen from behind, unsure where to go.
s05: A calm consulting scene with only ONE mascot: a soft rose-coloured mascot (same blob design) carefully looking through a large magnifying glass at a small tangled ball of thread lying on a small round table. A stethoscope lies next to it. On a shelf far behind, a small medicine bottle waits untouched. No white coat, no hospital, warm and gentle. First look closely, then act.
s06: A small grassy hilltop rising above a sea of soft grey-sage fog. On the hilltop stands a small round wooden table with an unfolded paper map that glows softly with warm golden light, like a lantern; on the map three simple winding paths: one rose, one terracotta, one green. No characters in this image. The fog begins to thin around the hill.
s07: The terracotta mascot sits at a small wooden desk under a warm lamp, holding a pencil and filling in a questionnaire sheet (only simple grey lines and small empty checkboxes on the paper, no letters). A cup of tea beside. Focused, calm.
s08: The terracotta mascot sits comfortably on a small armchair with a laptop on a low round table in front. On the laptop screen a friendly soft rose-coloured mascot (the psychologist, same blob design) is listening attentively. An empty speech bubble floats between them. Warm home light.
s09: Close top-down view of an open illustrated document lying on a round sand-coloured table: a simple relationship map with a few warm glowing golden dots, two darker sage-shaded areas, and one small loop-shaped path drawn in terracotta. A green mitten hand rests on the left edge and a terracotta mitten hand on the right edge. No letters or numbers on the paper.
s10: The fog has lifted. In the lower-middle of the frame the terracotta mascot (left) and the green mascot (right) sit at a small round table on a hilltop, seen from behind, with an open map on the table. Before them a clear sunny landscape where one sandy path splits into three roads leading into the hills: the left road leads to a small tree with a rose heart-shaped crown, the middle road to a sand-coloured hourglass-shaped rock, the right road to a calm green grove. All three roads are equally bright and inviting. Low warm sun on the horizon.
s11: A three-way fork of sandy paths in a clear, sunny, gentle landscape. The terracotta mascot stands at the fork seen from behind, holding an open map; the green mascot stands a little to the side, also seen from behind. The three roads (towards a rose heart-shaped tree, a sand hourglass-shaped rock and a green grove) are all equally bright. Nobody has chosen yet.
s12: Low, close view of a sandy path in warm morning light. The terracotta mascot takes one small step forward on the path, seen from behind and slightly from the side, holding a rolled map under its arm; the green mascot walks half a step behind. Soft grass, a few small flowers, gentle sun ahead. Hopeful but calm.
s13: Side view, perfectly symmetrical and very simple: the terracotta mascot sits on the left and the green mascot sits on the right of a small round sand-coloured table, facing each other, calmly talking (not hugging, not touching). On the table lies an open map. Completely plain warm ivory background, no room, no furniture except the table and two simple stools.
